messages:
Samira (CS): Quick sync — Pegasus private cutover day 3. Customer reports bursty TLS failures when talking to S3 (egress from 10.23.5.0/24). They said predictable tail latency is a renewal hotpoint. Filing ticket CS-8021.

Alex W: I pulled the ELB + natgw logs — saw TCP resets and 502s clustered around 03:12-03:16 UTC. Looks like PMTU issues: packets >1400B dropped. Recommend MSS clamping on their VPN or lower tunnel MTU to 1400.

Priya S: KMS concern: customer scheduled daily key rotation 02:00 UTC but nightly backups start 02:15 — will trigger transient decrypt latencies. Options: shift rotation to 03:30, or keep 02:00 but exclude backup role during rotation window. Also they want decrypt audit events forwarded to their security account and our audit bucket. Need cross-account policy + export path.

Jordan M: For customer troubleshooting, ask them to run this from their bastion during a maintenance window and paste output here:

```
curl -w "%{time_connect} %{time_starttransfer} %{http_code}\n" -sS -o /dev/null https://pegasus.internal/health --resolve pegasus.internal:443:10.23.5.12

# and a quick tcpdump: sudo tcpdump -n -s 0 -c 200 port 443 and host 10.23.5.12
```

Samira (CS): Actions: 1) @Alex W gather pcap + short summary -> attach to CS-8021; 2) @Priya S draft KMS cross-account decrypt policy + retention/export steps; 3) @Jordan M add small network pre-cutover checklist and KMS FAQ to onboarding repo. If not stabilized in 44h escalate to AM for renewal mitigation. :warning:

Alex W: Uploaded 30s pcap to CS-8021 — clear PMTU blackhole traces, MSS reduced to 1360 on the remote peer. I messaged their net team to flip MSS clamping; suggested temporary workaround: enable TCP MSS 1400 on their device.

Priya S: Draft policy for decrypt audit forwarding (snippet):

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::222233334444:role/pegasus-audit"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:555566667777:key/abcd-1234"
    }
  ]
}
```

I'll add cloudtrail-to-s3 export instructions and retention policy notes to the ticket.

Jordan M: Adding two docs to onboarding repo: (1) network pre-cutover checklist (MSS/MTU, traceroutes, sample tcpdump cmd), (2) KMS rotation FAQ describing rotation windows and coupling with backups. Will create PR and link in CS-8021. ETA: EOD.

OnboardBot: Ticket CS-8021 updated — assignees Alex W, Priya S, Jordan M. Status: investigation. Next update requested within 8 hours.

Samira (CS): Customer feedback captured: they want a short one-page "network readiness" checklist and an explicit KMS rotation compatibility note for backups. They appreciate responsiveness but warned renewal discussions will reference variance >=5% beyond baseline. Priya please flag renewal_risk if variance crosses threshold and coordinate with legal on any SLO amendment language.

Priya S: Added to renewal_risk tracker and created SLO amendment draft stub. Will engage Legal if monitoring shows >5% deviation. Also added customer's ask for daily rotation FAQ to the backlog.

Samira (CS): Please keep updates in CS-8021 (short, customer-facing timeline). I'll follow up with the AM after the 44h window if not resolved. Thanks team. :pray:
